title: Gladiator's Arena
description:
Unique Builds Every RunIn this rogue-lite arena survival game, select from a variety of upgrades, select different abilities to become stronger, and create overpowered builds every run.

7 different weapons to choose from

Features• Many Weapons to choose from

• Auto-target weapons by default

• Fast runs (under 20 minutes)

• Unique upgrades and abilities
description_short: Gladiator's Arena is a top-down arena shooter rogue-lite where you play as a gladiator wielding up to 7 different medieval weapons to fight off hordes of enemies. Choose from a variety of upgrades and abilities to create unique builds.
